summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: Package declares an npm preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (pinned to v1.3.13), extracts and chmods it executable, then invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated single-statement JS file (string-array rotator, hex _0xXXXX identifiers) that is unrelated to the package's stated library, whose lib/index.js trivially exports the string 'John'. setup.mjs is likewise obfuscated with hex-identifier / string-array patterns. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern — using Bun to execute a Node-invisible obfuscated payload at npm install time — bypasses Node-only supply-chain scanners; combined with the trivial declared library, there is no legitimate build or native-addon purpose served by the payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
